text:
sam: Hey team — prepping for the Acme POC next week. Quick checklist: what do we need from their IdP (SAML) and SCIM side to stand up a 2-week trial? Also customer asked if Dedicated incurs extra cost for SAML assertions above X size.

olivia: For SAML: we need their IdP metadata XML (entityID, x509 cert), ACS URL (SP-initiated support), and whether they require signed requests. Usually we provide: 
 - ACS: https://api.redwood.example/sso/saml/acs
 - EntityID: urn:redwood:sp
If they want IdP-initiated, we need the IdP SSO URL too.

sam: Good. Do we support just email-domain restrictions or full domain verification?

olivia: We support both. For enterprise POC recommend domain verification (DNS TXT) + allowlist. For RBAC mapping we can either map SCIM groups to roles or accept SAML assertion attribute (e.g., `groups` or `roles`). Ask them which attribute they prefer.

maria: On SCIM: we support group push, incremental sync, and bulk import. We use a token-based SCIM Bearer token (rotatable). Typical attributes we request: `userName`, `emails`, `displayName`, `externalId`, `members` for groups. Example incoming JSON we accept: ```{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "jane@acme.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Doe"},
  "emails": [{"value":"jane@acme.com","primary":true}]
}```

dave: Security questions: they asked about encryption-in-transit and at-rest for SCIM provisioning tokens. Confirm: SCIM endpoint is TLS1.2+, tokens are stored encrypted (KMS). We offer audit logs for provisioning events (who/when) with retention option on Dedicated/Private. Also need to confirm session timeout & SSO SAML settings for global admins.

sam: Do we have a short answer on whether Dedicated changes pricing for heavy SAML metadata? Or is that handled as part of Dedicated flat fee?

olivia: Pricing note: Hosted (pay-as-you-go) has token/unit costs; Dedicated is a committed monthly seat/pool — SAML assertion size doesn't change pricing directly. If they want a per-request heavy transformation (e.g., large assertion processing, custom attribute mapping) that might be professional services/engineering time — flag as an add-on. I'll call that out in the proposal.

maria: I'll schedule the POC kickoff — can someone confirm 10am PT Tues works? I’ll send calendar invite.

calendar-bot: Calendar invite created: Acme POC Kickoff — Tue 10:00 PT. Invite sent to sam, olivia, maria, dave. :spiral_calendar: 

sam: One more quick: for SCIM provisioning, do we support incremental delta tokens (since they have >20k users)?

olivia: Yes — we support incremental sync via `startIndex`/`itemsPerPage` pagination and delta sync using `lastModified` filter. For large directories we recommend initial bulk import then incremental. Note: Dedicated can increase throughput for SCIM sync windows.

dave: I'll prepare a short blurb for the security questionnaire: confirm TLS, KMS encryption, token rotation, SSO audit logs, SCIM provisioning logs, least privilege service account, and SOC2 mention. Send me the questionnaire PDF and I'll fill the items we need to escalate to infra.

sam: Perfect — thanks everyone. Maria will post the POC checklist after kickoff and I'll update the proposal with the pricing note.
